description: Overview of one supplement: description, typical uses, its top 5 biomarkers (with up to 3 PubMed citations each), goals, mechanism tags and cited safety contraindications. Contraindications include those recorded for what it contains (e.g. turmeric shows curcumin's), labelled with recorded_for; only cited rows are shown, so an empty list is not proof of safety. For all biomarkers use get_biomarkers_for_supplement; for drug interactions use get_supplement_interactions. The supplement may be a name or an Aviado canonical_id (from search_supplements or a candidates list). Check status first: needs_confirmation / no_match means the input did not resolve, data is null and next_step says how to retry.
name: get_supplement_info
title: Supplement overview and safety
